extracted.name: Ultimate Potato Soup
extracted.description: Potatoes, celery and onion are cooked with chicken broth and cream, and thickened with flour in this creamy, simple, potato soup.
instruction_lines: In a large pot, bring potatoes, celery and onion to a boil in 2 cups of broth. Cook until potatoes are tender, 15 minutes. Drain and reserve liquid.

Combine reserved broth and half-and-half in pot. In a bowl, combine melted butter and flour. Stir into half-and-half mixture over medium heat. Stir until thickened. Stir in reserved vegetables, remaining broth, bouillon and pepper. Heat through and serve.
